'''Armor''' in Matcha Flavoured comes in twelve sets. Base-metal sets are crafted; alloy sets are smithed onto copper, iron or diamond armor. Several sets have intrinsics, and the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] and [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] sets have a [[Set bonus|set bonus]].

In the video, the developer wanted every set to be "enticing enough that every player will have a different idea on what the best set and combination is."{{Cite video|quote=The goal with these sets was to make each option enticing enough that every player will have a different idea on what the best set and combination is.}}

== Full sets ==
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Set !! Armor !! Toughness !! Notes
|-
| [[Copper equipment|Copper]] || 10 || 0 || The cheapest metal set; plain copper armor protects undead from [[Warding]].
|-
| [[Iron equipment|Iron]] || 15 || 0 || Vanilla armor values with 350 durability per piece.
|-
| [[Steel equipment|Steel]] || 16 || 4 || Knockback resistance (0.5 for the full set) and [[Blast Protection]] on every piece.
|-
| [[Golden equipment|Golden]] || 12 || 0 || [[Fire Protection]] on every piece.
|-
| [[Diamond equipment|Diamond]] || 20 || 8 || 800 durability per piece; the base for electrum and adamant.
|-
| [[Shakudo equipment|Shakudo]] || 20 || 0 || [[Cleanse]], [[magic protection]] and a regeneration effect that grows with each piece worn.
|-
| [[Hepatizon equipment|Hepatizon]] || 20 || 0 || Each piece adds 10% movement speed.
|-
| [[Electrum equipment|Electrum]] || 20 || 12 || Each piece adds a level of [[Warding]]; the full set reaches warding 4 and grants Absorption.
|-
| [[Adamant equipment|Adamant]] || 20 || 12 || [[Doom]] on every piece, plus Protection I, Unbreaking II and knockback resistance.
|-
| [[Leather armor|Leather]] || 7 || 0 || Every piece adds 1 block of safe fall distance.
|-
| [[Sturdy leather armor|Sturdy Leather]] || 12 || 0 || Projectile Protection and 2 blocks of safe fall distance per piece; the boots add step height.
|-
| [[Chainmail armor|Chainmail]] || 15 || 0 || Craftable from iron chains; every piece has Thorns III.
|}
